question: What should be drawn outside and where should the kāma seed be placed in this step?
premises: The kāma seed is to be placed in the south.
An eight-petaled figure is to be drawn outside.
Both actions are part of the same instruction.
inference: One should place the kāma seed in the south and draw an eight-petaled lotus outside.
plain_english: Place the kāma seed in the south and draw an eight-petaled lotus outside.
